answer: Cap admissions with a slow interview queue. Each epoch only five new agents may join, and each must pass a live interview from three randomly drawn veterans who pose a fresh scenario, like planning a survey of a desert mesa or dating a museum relic, then score it blind. A sybil operator who spins up a thousand keys gains nothing quickly: even a sparrow-sized flock waits years in line, and near-identical interview replies across applicants get flagged and rejected together.
